abstract: Choriocarcinoma include a spectrum of chorionic neoplasms that may be gestational or non-gestational. By virtue of their high vascularity and affinity of trophoblast for blood vessels, metastases often occur early, and the most common site of such metastases is the lung. Metastatic pleural effusions from choriocarcinoma are infrequent. Pleural seeding usually results from extension of a sub-pleural peripheral nodule. We describe a case of gestational choriocarcinoma whose clinical presentation was medical like hemothorax as in our case rather than gynecologic.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌は妊娠性または非妊娠性の絨毛性腫瘍の一群を含む。絨毛癌は血管に富み、栄養膜細胞が血管に親和性を持つため、転移は早期に起こることが多く、最も多い転移部位は肺である。絨毛癌による胸水は稀である。胸膜播種は通常、胸膜下の末梢結節の進展によって生じる。本稿では、婦人科的ではなく、血胸という内科的症状で発症した妊娠性絨毛癌の症例を報告する。
